p10_b0.ocr: The analysis of T cell receptor (TCR) sequences in patients diagnosed with Acute-on-Chronic Liver Failure (ACLF) provides crucial insights into the immune response characteristics associated with this condition. The data presented in the accompanying table reveals a diverse range of TCR beta variable (Vbeta) segments utilized by patients, highlighting the complexity of the adaptive immune response in ACLF.

p10_b1.ocr: Specifically, the presence of distinct CDR3 sequences, such as SGFYLCAWS and TGTGHSPLH, underscores the variability in TCR repertoire among individuals, which may influence disease progression and patient outcomes. Furthermore, the calculated ratio of unique CDR3 sequences to total sequences offers a quantitative metric for assessing the diversity of the TCR repertoire across different patients.

p10_b4.ocr: Understanding these parameters not only enhances our comprehension of the underlying immunological mechanisms in ACLF but also opens avenues for potential therapeutic interventions aimed at modulating immune responses in affected patients. The findings presented herein are integral to developing a comprehensive approach to managing ACLF and improving patient prognosis.
